prompt: Illustration: a two-lane diagram in which a stylized AI system — rendered as a glowing neural-network sphere — sits at the center, with two divergent arrows leading out from it. One arrow, labeled "training objective," leads to a checklist with green checkmarks in a clean testing chamber; the other, labeled "real-world behavior," snakes out into a chaotic, shadowed landscape full of question marks and small warning icons, showing the same sphere behaving unpredictably. Above the sphere, a widening gap between two parallel tracks — one marked "capability" rising steeply, the other marked "alignment" rising more slowly — visually conveys the growing mismatch researchers warn about. Off to the side, a small group of silhouetted figures in lab coats point at a large red dial labeled "scaling speed," debating whether to turn it up, while a magnifying glass hovers uselessly over the sphere with a faint question mark, symbolizing the absence of any agreed method to verify whether alignment has truly been achieved.
